articles.title: Coast Guard Day — 4 August (Indian Coast Guard Raising Day Context)
articles.title_hi: तटरक्षक दिवस — 4 अगस्त (Indian Coast Guard Raising Day संदर्भ)
articles.summary: While the Indian Coast Guard celebrates its Raising Day on 1 February, 4 August is observed globally as U.S. Coast Guard Day; India highlights ICG's coastal security role during monsoon rescue operations.
articles.summary_hi: Indian Coast Guard Raising Day 1 February को मनाता है, 4 August globally U.S. Coast Guard Day है; भारत monsoon rescue operations में ICG की coastal security भूमिका highlight करता है।
articles.content:
4 August marks the founding of the U.S. Coast Guard (1790). For Indian exams, the Indian Coast Guard (ICG) Raising Day is on 1 February — ICG was formally established in 1978 under the Coast Guard Act, 1978, and operates under the Ministry of Defence.

In August 2026, ICG conducted monsoon rescue operations off the Maharashtra and Goa coasts. ICG is the fourth armed force of India, after Army, Navy, and Air Force.

For IB ACIO: ICG Raising Day — 1 February; established 1978; Coast Guard Act 1978; MoD.
articles.content_hi:
ICG Raising Day: 1 February (1978, Coast Guard Act 1978)। MoD। 4 Aug — US Coast Guard Day (global)।

IB ACIO: ICG 1 Feb — याद रखें।

articles.question_hi: Indian Coast Guard Raising Day कब मनाया जाता है?
articles.explanation: Indian Coast Guard Raising Day is 1 February; ICG was established in 1978.
articles.explanation_hi: Indian Coast Guard Raising Day 1 फरवरी है; ICG 1978 में स्थापित हुआ।

articles.title: UNESCO Adds Santiniketan to World Heritage List
articles.title_hi: UNESCO ने Santiniketan को World Heritage List में शामिल किया
articles.summary: UNESCO inscribed Santiniketan, West Bengal — founded by Rabindranath Tagore — as India's latest cultural World Heritage Site at the extended World Heritage Committee session.
articles.summary_hi: UNESCO ने Rabindranath Tagore द्वारा स्थापित West Bengal के Santiniketan को extended World Heritage Committee session में भारत की नवीनतम cultural World Heritage Site के रूप में inscribed किया।
articles.content:
In August 2026, UNESCO inscribed Santiniketan, West Bengal, on the World Heritage List as a cultural site. Founded by Rabindranath Tagore, Santiniketan embodies the Visva-Bharati University's humanist educational philosophy and architectural heritage.

India now has 44+ UNESCO World Heritage Sites (cultural, natural, and mixed). Recent additions include Hoysala temples and Moidams. UNESCO HQ is in Paris; World Heritage Convention adopted 1972.

For IB ACIO: Santiniketan UNESCO 2026, Tagore, Visva-Bharati, WHC Convention 1972.
articles.content_hi:
Santiniketan: UNESCO World Heritage 2026, Tagore, Visva-Bharati (West Bengal)। WH Convention — 1972, UNESCO Paris।

IB ACIO: Santiniketan UNESCO — याद रखें।
articles.question: Santiniketan, inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2026, was founded by:
articles.question_hi: 2026 में UNESCO World Heritage Site के रूप में inscribed Santiniketan के संस्थापक कौन थे?
articles.explanation: Santiniketan was founded by Rabindranath Tagore, Nobel laureate in Literature (1913).
articles.explanation_hi: Santiniketan Nobel laureate Rabindranath Tagore (1913, Literature) द्वारा स्थापित किया गया।

articles.title: Government Releases Draft Rules under Broadcasting Services Regulation Bill
articles.title_hi: सरकार ने Broadcasting Services Regulation Bill के तहत Draft Rules जारी किए
articles.summary: MIB released draft rules for the Broadcasting Services (Regulation) Bill, covering OTT platforms, digital news, and content classification standards.
articles.summary_hi: MIB ने Broadcasting Services (Regulation) Bill हेतु draft rules जारी किए, जो OTT platforms, digital news और content classification standards को कवर करते हैं।
articles.content:
In August 2026, the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting (MIB) released draft rules under the Broadcasting Services (Regulation) Bill. The framework extends content regulation to OTT platforms and digital news publishers with a three-tier grievance redressal mechanism.

Content is classified into age-based categories (U, U/A, A). Self-regulatory bodies at the industry level form the second tier. MIB retains appellate authority.

For IB ACIO: Broadcasting Bill, MIB, OTT regulation, three-tier grievance mechanism.
articles.content_hi:
Broadcasting Bill draft rules: MIB, OTT + digital news regulation, three-tier grievance, age classification (U/UA/A)।

IB ACIO: MIB broadcasting — याद रखें।
articles.question: Draft rules under the Broadcasting Services (Regulation) Bill were released by:
articles.question_hi: Broadcasting Services (Regulation) Bill के तहत draft rules किसने जारी किए?
articles.explanation: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting (MIB) released the draft broadcasting rules.
articles.explanation_hi: सूचना और प्रसारण मंत्रालय (MIB) ने draft broadcasting rules जारी किए।

articles.title: Vineet Joshi Appointed Chairperson, CBSE
articles.title_hi: विनीत जोशी को CBSE अध्यक्ष नियुक्त
articles.summary: The ACC appointed Vineet Joshi, former DG NTA, as Chairperson of the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) for a three-year term.
articles.summary_hi: ACC ने पूर्व DG NTA विनीत जोशी को तीन वर्ष के कार्यकाल हेतु Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) का अध्यक्ष नियुक्त किया।
articles.content:
In August 2026, Vineet Joshi was appointed Chairperson of CBSE under the Ministry of Education. He previously served as Director General of the National Testing Agency (NTA). CBSE is India's largest school education board, headquartered in New Delhi.

CBSE conducts Class 10 and 12 board exams and affiliates schools nationally and internationally. Joshi's tenure focuses on competency-based assessment reforms.

For IB ACIO: CBSE Chairperson — Vineet Joshi, ex-DG NTA, MoE.
articles.content_hi:
CBSE Chairperson — Vineet Joshi (Aug 2026), ex-DG NTA, MoE। HQ — New Delhi।

IB ACIO: CBSE Joshi — याद रखें।
articles.question: Vineet Joshi, appointed CBSE Chairperson in August 2026, previously served as DG of:
articles.question_hi: अगस्त 2026 में CBSE अध्यक्ष नियुक्त विनीत जोशी पूर्व में किसके DG थे?
articles.explanation: Vineet Joshi was former Director General of the National Testing Agency (NTA).
articles.explanation_hi: विनीत जोशी National Testing Agency (NTA) के पूर्व महानिदेशक थे।

articles.title: India's First Indigenous Semiconductor Chip 'Vikram-1' Fabricated at IIT Bombay
articles.title_hi: भारत की पहली स्वदेशी Semiconductor Chip 'Vikram-1' IIT Bombay में Fabricated
articles.summary: Researchers at IIT Bombay, under the India Semiconductor Mission, fabricated 'Vikram-1', a 28nm RISC-V microcontroller chip for IoT and defence applications.
articles.summary_hi: India Semiconductor Mission के तहत IIT Bombay researchers ने IoT और defence applications हेतु 28nm RISC-V microcontroller chip 'Vikram-1' fabricated की।
articles.content:
In August 2026, IIT Bombay researchers fabricated 'Vikram-1', India's first indigenous 28nm RISC-V microcontroller chip under the India Semiconductor Mission (ISM). ISM was launched in 2021 with a Rs 76,000 crore outlay to build the semiconductor ecosystem.

The chip targets IoT, automotive, and defence electronics. Tata Electronics and Micron's Sanand plant represent parallel commercial fabrication efforts.

For IB ACIO: Vikram-1 chip, IIT Bombay, ISM 2021, RISC-V architecture, 28nm.
articles.content_hi:
Vikram-1: IIT Bombay, 28nm RISC-V chip। India Semiconductor Mission (2021, Rs 76,000 cr)।

IB ACIO: ISM 2021 — याद रखें।
articles.question: India Semiconductor Mission (ISM) was launched in:
articles.question_hi: India Semiconductor Mission (ISM) कब शुरू की गई?
articles.explanation: India Semiconductor Mission was launched in 2021 with Rs 76,000 crore outlay.
articles.explanation_hi: India Semiconductor Mission 2021 में 76,000 करोड़ रुपये के परिव्यय के साथ शुरू की गई।

articles.title: India's Forex Reserves Touch Record $700 Billion
articles.title_hi: भारत का Forex Reserves रिकॉर्ड $700 Billion स्पर्श
articles.summary: RBI data showed India's foreign exchange reserves crossing $700 billion for the first time, driven by strong FDI inflows and reduced import bill on oil prices.
articles.summary_hi: RBI data ने भारत के foreign exchange reserves का पहली बार $700 billion पार करना दिखाया, strong FDI inflows और oil prices पर कम import bill से driven।
articles.content:
In August 2026, RBI reported India's forex reserves exceeding $700 billion — a record high. Components include foreign currency assets, gold, SDRs, and IMF reserve position.

Strong services exports, remittances, and FDI in manufacturing contributed to the build-up. RBI intervenes in the forex market to manage rupee volatility.

For IB ACIO: Forex reserves $700 bn milestone, RBI, components — FCA, gold, SDRs.
articles.content_hi:
Forex reserves: $700 bn milestone (Aug 2026), RBI। Components — FCA, gold, SDRs, IMF position।

IB ACIO: $700 bn forex — याद रखें।

articles.question_hi: भारत के foreign exchange reserves किसके द्वारा maintained और reported किए जाते हैं?
articles.explanation: The Reserve Bank of India maintains and publishes official forex reserve data.
articles.explanation_hi: Reserve Bank of India official forex reserve data maintain और publish करता है।

articles.title: India-Japan Sign Defence Equipment Cooperation on UNICORN NALE
articles.title_hi: India-Japan ने UNICORN NALE पर Defence Equipment Cooperation पर हस्ताक्षर किए
articles.summary: India and Japan signed an agreement for joint development of UNICORN NALE (Networked Acoustic Linked Equipment) anti-submarine warfare systems for naval platforms.
articles.summary_hi: India और Japan ने naval platforms हेतु UNICORN NALE (Networked Acoustic Linked Equipment) anti-submarine warfare systems के joint development पर agreement पर हस्ताक्षर किए।
articles.content:
In August 2026, India and Japan signed a defence equipment cooperation agreement on the UNICORN NALE anti-submarine warfare (ASW) system. The deal strengthens the Special Strategic and Global Partnership under the 2023 India-Japan defence cooperation framework.

Japan supplies advanced acoustic systems; India integrates them on naval platforms through DRDO and naval shipyards. Malabar exercises include Japan as a permanent participant alongside India, US, and Australia.

For IB ACIO: India-Japan UNICORN NALE, ASW, Malabar exercise.
articles.content_hi:
India-Japan: UNICORN NALE ASW agreement (Aug 2026)। Malabar — IN, US, JP, AU।

IB ACIO: India-Japan defence — याद रखें।

articles.explanation: Malabar permanently includes India, the United States, Japan, and Australia.

articles.title: NMCG Approves 12 Projects under Namami Gange 2.0
articles.title_hi: NMCG ने Namami Gange 2.0 के तहत 12 Projects स्वीकृत किए
articles.summary: The National Mission for Clean Ganga approved 12 sewage treatment and riverfront development projects worth Rs 3,200 crore across Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, and West Bengal.
articles.summary_hi: National Mission for Clean Ganga ने Uttar Pradesh, Bihar और West Bengal में Rs 3,200 crore के 12 sewage treatment और riverfront development projects स्वीकृत किए।
articles.content:
In August 2026, NMCG (National Mission for Clean Ganga) under Jal Shakti Ministry approved 12 projects under Namami Gange 2.0, totalling Rs 3,200 crore. Projects include STPs (sewage treatment plants) in Varanasi, Patna, and Kolkata stretches.

Namami Gange was launched in 2014 as an Integrated Conservation Mission. NMCG is the implementing agency. Goal: abate pollution and maintain ecological flow in the Ganga.

For IB ACIO: Namami Gange 2014, NMCG, Jal Shakti Ministry, Namami Gange 2.0.
articles.content_hi:
Namami Gange: launch 2014, NMCG (Jal Shakti)। 2.0 — 12 projects, Rs 3,200 cr (Aug 2026)।

IB ACIO: Namami Gange 2014 — याद रखें।

articles.question_hi: Namami Gange programme कब शुरू किया गया?
articles.explanation: Namami Gange was launched in 2014 as an Integrated Conservation Mission for the Ganga.
articles.explanation_hi: Namami Gange 2014 में Ganga के लिए Integrated Conservation Mission के रूप में शुरू किया गया।

articles.title: Chess: Gukesh D Wins Sinquefield Cup 2026
articles.title_hi: शतरंज: Gukesh D ने Sinquefield Cup 2026 जीता
articles.summary: World Champion D Gukesh won the Sinquefield Cup 2026 in Saint Louis, defeating a field including Fabiano Caruana and Alireza Firouzja.
articles.summary_hi: World Champion D Gukesh ने Saint Louis में Sinquefield Cup 2026 जीता, Fabiano Caruana और Alireza Firouzja सहित field को हराया।
articles.content:
In August 2026, India's D Gukesh won the Sinquefield Cup in Saint Louis, USA — one of chess's strongest annual tournaments. Gukesh became World Champion in 2024, becoming the youngest undisputed champion at age 18.

He is from Chennai, trained at the Westbridge Anand Chess Academy ecosystem. India's chess boom includes Praggnanandhaa, Arjun Erigaisi, and Vaishali R.

For IB ACIO: D Gukesh, World Champion 2024, youngest undisputed champion, Sinquefield Cup 2026.
articles.content_hi:
D Gukesh: World Champion 2024 (youngest, age 18), Sinquefield Cup 2026 winner, Chennai।

IB ACIO: Gukesh 2024 champion — याद रखें।

articles.question_hi: D Gukesh सबसे कम उम्र के undisputed World Chess Champion कब बने?
articles.explanation: D Gukesh became World Chess Champion in 2024 at age 18.
articles.explanation_hi: D Gukesh 2024 में 18 वर्ष की उम्र में World Chess Champion बने।

articles.title: India Signs Critical Minerals MoU with Argentina for Lithium
articles.title_hi: भारत ने Lithium हेतु Argentina के साथ Critical Minerals MoU पर हस्ताक्षर किए
articles.summary: India and Argentina signed an MoU on critical minerals cooperation, focusing on lithium exploration in the 'Lithium Triangle' provinces of Catamarca and Jujuy.
articles.summary_hi: India और Argentina ने critical minerals cooperation पर MoU पर हस्ताक्षर किए, Catamarca और Jujuy provinces के 'Lithium Triangle' में lithium exploration पर focus।
articles.content:
In August 2026, India and Argentina signed an MoU on critical minerals, focusing on lithium and copper exploration. KABIL (Khanij Bidesh India Ltd), a JV of NALCO, Hindustan Copper, and MECL under the Ministry of Mines, leads overseas mineral acquisitions.

Argentina is part of the Lithium Triangle (Argentina, Bolivia, Chile). The MoU supports India's EV battery and energy storage ambitions under the National Critical Minerals Mission.

For IB ACIO: KABIL, Lithium Triangle, Argentina MoU, Ministry of Mines.
articles.content_hi:
India-Argentina: critical minerals MoU (lithium)। KABIL — NALCO+HCL+MECL JV, Ministry of Mines। Lithium Triangle — AR, BO, CL।

IB ACIO: KABIL lithium — याद रखें।
articles.question: KABIL (Khanij Bidesh India Ltd) is a joint venture under which ministry?
articles.question_hi: KABIL (Khanij Bidesh India Ltd) किस मंत्रालय के अधीन JV है?
articles.explanation: KABIL operates under the Ministry of Mines for overseas critical mineral acquisition.
articles.explanation_hi: KABIL overseas critical mineral acquisition हेतु Ministry of Mines के अधीन कार्य करता है।
